title: Low On Textures
description: This texture pack changes the textures of tools, blocks, mobs (coming soon), and some game elements.
body:
I am not the creator of this project, it was created by VentaBlack on CurseForge, but I was allowed to publish it here.
This texture pack removes unnecessary shades from the textures of blocks and tools (according to the author, the textures of mobs will also be changed soon). Additionally, the author of this texture pack has added a few details and corrected some texture errors from the game.
